summary: Schema-2/3 catalog ownership and observation declare tagged sha256 hashes over exact file bytes. Legacy bare skill digests address BOM-decoded, CRLF-normalized text through SkillMirror.sha256. Feeding tagged raw declarations into that canonical comparison falsely marks unchanged skills as drift; stripping only the prefix still compares different domains for BOM or CRLF. The source correction uses existing FileSnapshot.RawBytes in the shared Doctor/Upgrade drift path for tagged declarations, retains canonical verification for bare declarations, and fails closed when a tagged declaration has only decoded snapshots. Missing, unobserved and undeclared-file classifications remain distinct. Real schema-2/3 filesystem controls cover product and owner files with LF/CRLF/BOM, raw-only tampering, missing copies and legacy behavior. The public provenance/schema and API remain unchanged. This record establishes the source contract and lesson only; coherent producer publication and fresh installed Doctor acceptance remain separate.
title: Catalog skill hashes address raw bytes; legacy skill hashes address canonical text
